name: EUROe
oneLiner: EUROe was Membrane's Finnish EMI-licensed euro stablecoin, decommissioned in 2026 after Paxos acquired Membrane and switched the platform to redemption-only.

obituary.obituary: Paxos completed its acquisition of Membrane Finance in February 2025 to absorb its Finnish EMI license and EU stablecoin issuance rails. As Paxos consolidated its product lineup, the EUROe business line was decommissioned and the platform transitioned to redemption-only mode in May 2026, with no new minting or trading. Existing holders were instructed to complete KYC and redeem outstanding EUROe 1:1 for euros via SEPA through Paxos Issuance Europe.

collateral: Euro fiat reserves and euro-denominated assets held by Membrane Finance for issued EUROe
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 euro issuance and redemption through Membrane's verified-customer platform, with public transparency and regulation pages describing reserve attestations

mintAuthority.summary: EUROe was a Finnish EMI-licensed euro EMT solely issued by Membrane Finance (later Paxos Issuance Europe). The token is an OpenZeppelin role-based ERC-20 whose MINTER_ROLE mints (direct or batch) against the issuer's euro reserves; all roles are internal to the issuer. The contract is UUPS-upgradeable with no on-chain timelock.

controls.label: Membrane/Paxos MINTER_ROLE backend
controls.evidence: EUROe developer docs define a MINTER_ROLE that mints new EUROe via direct or backend-driven batch mint (checksummed batches supplied by the issuer's backend); all roles are strictly internal to the issuer against euro fiat reserves.

controls.label: Admin / proxy-owner role (UUPS upgrade authority)
controls.evidence: Docs state admin and proxy-owner roles can reassign roles and upgrade the UUPS contract, with no smart-contract timelock; these roles were planned to migrate to a multisig but are operated internally by the issuer.

review.evidence: EUROe developer portal and Runtime Verification audit describe OpenZeppelin role-based access with a MINTER_ROLE for direct/batch issuance, plus admin and UUPS proxy-owner roles held internally by the issuer; no public on-chain Safe address or threshold was independently confirmed.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Mechanism established from issuer docs and contract source; the live on-chain admin/minter address and any multisig migration were not independently resolved, and the issuer has moved EUROe to redemption-only wind-down.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm whether admin/proxy-owner roles ever migrated to a multisig and resolve the live on-chain MINTER_ROLE holder.
